question: Emma found 6 maple leaves on the playground and then found 7 more by the big oak tree. How many maple leaves does Emma have in total?
questionFr: Emma a trouvé 6 feuilles d'érable dans la cour de récréation, puis 7 autres près du grand chêne. Combien de feuilles d'érable Emma a-t-elle en tout?
hint: Try counting on from 6 by holding up fingers for each new leaf you find.
steps: Start at 6 and count on 7 more: 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13

question: There were 15 hockey pucks in the bag. The coach used 8 pucks for practice. How many pucks are left in the bag?
questionFr: Il y avait 15 rondelles de hockey dans le sac. L'entraîneur a utilisé 8 rondelles pour la pratique. Combien de rondelles reste-t-il dans le sac?
hint: Start at 15 and count backwards 8 times to find how many are left.
steps: Start with 15 pucks and take away 8: 15 - 8 = ?
Count back 8 from 15: 14, 13, 12, 11, 10, 9, 8, 7 — the answer is 7

question: At the Tim Hortons Timbits party, the boxes each held 2 Timbits. If there are 5 boxes, how many Timbits are there altogether? (Count by 2s!)
questionFr: À la fête de Timbits de Tim Hortons, chaque boîte contenait 2 Timbits. S'il y a 5 boîtes, combien de Timbits y a-t-il en tout? (Compte par 2!)
hint: Skip count by 2s five times: 2, 4, 6, ... keep going!

question: Jake scored 14 points in his hockey game. His friend Liam scored 9 points. Who scored more points, and by how many?
questionFr: Jake a marqué 14 points dans son match de hockey. Son ami Liam en a marqué 9. Qui a marqué le plus de points, et de combien?
hint: Find the bigger number first, then figure out the difference by counting up from the smaller number.
steps: 14 is greater than 9, so Jake scored more
14 - 9 = 5, so Jake scored 5 more points than Liam

question: Sophia has 2 nickels and 3 pennies in her piggy bank. How many cents does she have in total?
questionFr: Sophia a 2 pièces de 5 cents et 3 pièces de 1 cent dans sa tirelire. Combien de cents a-t-elle en tout?
hint: A nickel is worth 5 cents. Add up all the nickels first, then add the pennies.

question: At the school's winter fair, 34 students bought hot chocolate and 47 students bought apple cider. How many students bought a warm drink in total?
questionFr: À la fête hivernale de l'école, 34 élèves ont acheté du chocolat chaud et 47 ont acheté du cidre de pomme. Combien d'élèves ont acheté une boisson chaude en tout?
hint: Add the tens together first, then add the ones. Don't forget to regroup if needed!

question: A maple syrup farm collected 92 litres of sap in the morning. By the afternoon, 35 litres had been used to make syrup. How many litres of sap were left?
questionFr: Une érablière a collecté 92 litres de sève le matin. L'après-midi, 35 litres ont été utilisés pour faire du sirop. Combien de litres de sève restait-il?
hint: Try subtracting the tens first, then the ones. Watch out for regrouping!
steps: 92 - 35: Start with the ones, 2 - 5 needs regrouping, borrow from the tens to get 12 - 5 = 7
Then subtract the tens: 8 - 3 = 5, giving 57 litres remaining

question: The school bus arrives at 8 o'clock. Hockey practice starts one and a half hours later. What time does hockey practice start?
questionFr: L'autobus scolaire arrive à 8 heures. La pratique de hockey commence une heure et demie plus tard. À quelle heure commence la pratique de hockey?
hint: Add 1 hour to 8:00 first, then add another half hour (30 minutes).
steps: 9:00 + 30 minutes = 9:30, so hockey practice starts at 9:30

question: Maya's camping tent is 2 metres long. Her sleeping bag is 150 centimetres long. How much longer is the tent than the sleeping bag? (Hint: 1 metre = 100 centimetres)
questionFr: La tente de camping de Maya mesure 2 mètres de long. Son sac de couchage mesure 150 centimètres. De combien la tente est-elle plus longue que le sac de couchage?
hint: Convert the tent length to centimetres before comparing.
steps: 200 cm - 150 cm = 50 cm, so the tent is 50 cm longer

question: Ben has 3 quarters and 1 dime in his pocket. How much money does Ben have? (Quarter = 25¢, Dime = 10¢)
questionFr: Ben a 3 pièces de 25 cents et 1 pièce de 10 cents dans sa poche. Combien d'argent Ben a-t-il? (25 cents = 25¢, 10 cents = 10¢)
hint: Add up the value of all the quarters first, then add the dime.

question: At a hockey tournament, there are 4 teams. Each team has 5 players on the ice at a time. How many players are on the ice altogether?
questionFr: Lors d'un tournoi de hockey, il y a 4 équipes. Chaque équipe a 5 joueurs sur la glace en même temps. Combien de joueurs y a-t-il sur la glace en tout?
hint: Think of this as adding 5 four times, or use your 4 times table.
steps: Multiply the number of teams by players per team: 4 × 5

question: A baker at a Tim Hortons made 24 muffins and wants to put them equally into 4 boxes to give to the school. How many muffins will go in each box?
questionFr: Un boulanger de Tim Hortons a fait 24 muffins et veut les mettre également dans 4 boîtes pour les donner à l'école. Combien de muffins iront dans chaque boîte?
hint: Think: what number times 4 equals 24?

question: A pizza at the school lunch was cut into 4 equal slices. Alex ate 1 slice. What fraction of the pizza did Alex eat?
questionFr: Une pizza au dîner scolaire a été coupée en 4 parts égales. Alex a mangé 1 part. Quelle fraction de la pizza Alex a-t-il mangée?
hint: The number of total slices is the bottom number (denominator), and the slices eaten is the top number (numerator).
steps: The pizza was cut into 4 equal slices, so the denominator is 4
Alex ate 1 slice, so the fraction is 1/4

question: The school garden is shaped like a rectangle. It is 8 metres long and 3 metres wide. What is the perimeter of the garden?
questionFr: Le jardin de l'école a la forme d'un rectangle. Il mesure 8 mètres de long et 3 mètres de large. Quel est le périmètre du jardin?
hint: Perimeter means the total distance around the outside. Add all four sides together.
steps: A rectangle has 2 long sides and 2 short sides: 8 + 8 + 3 + 3

question: A bar graph shows how many goals each player scored this season: Chloe scored 5, Noah scored 8, and Priya scored 3. How many more goals did Noah score than Chloe and Priya combined?
questionFr: Un diagramme à barres montre combien de buts chaque joueur a marqués cette saison: Chloé en a marqué 5, Noah en a marqué 8 et Priya en a marqué 3. Combien de buts de plus Noah a-t-il marqué que Chloé et Priya combinés?
hint: First add Chloe and Priya's goals together, then compare to Noah's total.
steps: Noah scored 8, and 8 - 8 = 0, so Noah scored the same amount, not more

question: At a Canadian Hockey League game, there are 8 rows of seats in a section. Each row has 9 seats. If all seats are taken, how many fans are in that section?
questionFr: Lors d'un match de la Ligue canadienne de hockey, une section a 8 rangées de sièges, et chaque rangée a 9 sièges. Si tous les sièges sont occupés, combien de spectateurs y a-t-il dans cette section?
hint: Use your 8 times table or your 9 times table — both will work!
steps: Multiply the number of rows by the seats per row: 8 × 9

question: A camping supply store received a shipment of 96 tent pegs. They want to pack them equally into bags of 6. How many bags can they fill?
questionFr: Un magasin de camping a reçu une livraison de 96 piquets de tente. Ils veulent les emballer également dans des sacs de 6. Combien de sacs peuvent-ils remplir?
hint: Think about how many groups of 6 fit into 96. Use long division step by step.
steps: 96 ÷ 6: 6 goes into 9 once (6), remainder 3. Bring down 6 to get 36
6 goes into 36 exactly 6 times, so the answer is 16 bags

question: At the school bake sale, a slice of butter tart cost $1.35. Which digit is in the tenths place?
questionFr: À la vente de pâtisseries de l'école, une tranche de tarte au beurre coûtait 1,35 $. Quel chiffre est à la position des dixièmes?
hint: In a decimal number, the first digit after the decimal point is in the tenths place.
steps: The number is $1.35 — look at the digits after the decimal point
The first digit after the decimal point is 3, which is in the tenths place

question: Two friends are eating pancakes with maple syrup. Ryan ate 3/4 of his pancake and Kira ate 2/4 of hers. Who ate more?
questionFr: Deux amis mangent des crêpes avec du sirop d'érable. Ryan a mangé 3/4 de sa crêpe et Kira en a mangé 2/4. Qui en a mangé le plus?
hint: When the denominators (bottom numbers) are the same, just compare the numerators (top numbers).
steps: Both fractions have the same denominator (4), so compare the numerators: 3 vs. 2
3 > 2, so Ryan (3/4) ate more than Kira (2/4)

question: The school gym has a rectangular floor that is 12 metres long and 7 metres wide. What is the area of the gym floor?
questionFr: Le plancher du gymnase scolaire est rectangulaire: 12 mètres de long et 7 mètres de large. Quelle est l'aire du plancher?
hint: Area of a rectangle = length × width.
steps: Use the formula: Area = length × width = 12 × 7

question: A school is ordering jerseys for 24 hockey teams. Each team needs 18 jerseys. How many jerseys are needed altogether?
questionFr: Une école commande des maillots pour 24 équipes de hockey. Chaque équipe a besoin de 18 maillots. Combien de maillots sont nécessaires en tout?
hint: Break apart one of the numbers to make multiplication easier. Try 24 × 18 = 24 × 10 + 24 × 8.

question: A maple syrup festival sold 2,184 small bottles of syrup over 7 days. If the same number was sold each day, how many bottles were sold per day?
questionFr: Un festival du sirop d'érable a vendu 2 184 petites bouteilles de sirop en 7 jours. Si le même nombre a été vendu chaque jour, combien de bouteilles ont été vendues par jour?
hint: Divide the total number of bottles by the number of days.
steps: 2,184 ÷ 7: 7 goes into 21 three times (21), remainder 0. Bring down 8: 7 goes into 8 once (7), remainder 1. Bring down 4: 14 ÷ 7 = 2
The answer is 312 bottles per day

question: During a camping trip, Mia drank 2/8 of a water bottle in the morning and 3/8 in the afternoon. What fraction of the bottle did she drink in total?
questionFr: Lors d'une sortie de camping, Mia a bu 2/8 d'une bouteille d'eau le matin et 3/8 l'après-midi. Quelle fraction de la bouteille a-t-elle bue en tout?
hint: When fractions have the same denominator, you only add the numerators (top numbers).
steps: Both fractions have denominator 8, so add the numerators: 2 + 3 = 5
The total fraction is 5/8 of the water bottle

question: At Tim Hortons, a large coffee costs $2.19 and a muffin costs $1.89. If you pay with a $5 bill, how much change do you get?
questionFr: Au Tim Hortons, un grand café coûte 2,19 $ et un muffin coûte 1,89 $. Si tu paies avec un billet de 5 $, combien de monnaie recevras-tu?
hint: First add the cost of both items, then subtract from $5.00.

question: A fish tank at the school science fair is 50 cm long, 20 cm wide, and 30 cm tall. What is the volume of the fish tank?
questionFr: Un aquarium à la foire scientifique de l'école mesure 50 cm de long, 20 cm de large et 30 cm de haut. Quel est le volume de l'aquarium?
hint: Volume of a rectangular prism = length × width × height.

question: A recipe for bannock bread uses 3/4 of a cup of flour. If Grandma wants to make 2/3 of the recipe, how much flour does she need?
questionFr: Une recette de pain bannique utilise 3/4 de tasse de farine. Si grand-maman veut faire 2/3 de la recette, de quelle quantité de farine a-t-elle besoin?
hint: To multiply fractions, multiply the numerators together and the denominators together, then simplify.
steps: Simplify 6/12 by dividing numerator and denominator by 6: 6/12 = 1/2 cup

question: A hockey player scored 12 goals in 8 games. At this rate, how many goals would she score in 20 games?
questionFr: Une joueuse de hockey a marqué 12 buts en 8 matchs. À ce rythme, combien de buts marquerait-elle en 20 matchs?
hint: First find the rate (goals per game), then multiply by 20.
steps: Goals per game: 12 ÷ 8 = 1.5 goals per game

question: A Tim Hortons franchise raised $3,200 for a local charity and donated 25% of it to the food bank. How much money went to the food bank?
questionFr: Un franchisé de Tim Hortons a amassé 3 200 $ pour un organisme de bienfaisance local et en a donné 25 % à la banque alimentaire. Combien d'argent est allé à la banque alimentaire?
hint: 25% means 25 out of 100. You can also think of 25% as one quarter (÷ 4).

question: During a winter camping trip in Ontario, the temperature was -8°C at midnight. By noon the next day, it had risen 15 degrees. What was the temperature at noon?
questionFr: Lors d'un voyage de camping hivernal en Ontario, la température était de -8 °C à minuit. Le lendemain à midi, elle avait augmenté de 15 degrés. Quelle était la température à midi?
hint: Starting from a negative number and adding a positive number — use a number line to help!

question: At a school bake sale, the student council used this expression to calculate profits: 5 × (12 - 4) + 3². What is the value?
questionFr: Lors d'une vente de pâtisseries à l'école, le conseil étudiant a utilisé cette expression pour calculer les profits : 5 × (12 - 4) + 3². Quelle est la valeur?
hint: Remember BEDMAS: Brackets first, then Exponents, then Multiplication, then Addition.

question: The temperature in Winnipeg was -14°C on Monday. On Tuesday it dropped another 7°C. On Wednesday it rose 18°C. What was the temperature on Wednesday?
questionFr: La température à Winnipeg était de -14 °C lundi. Mardi, elle a baissé de 7 °C de plus. Mercredi, elle a monté de 18 °C. Quelle était la température mercredi?
hint: Work through this step by step: first find Tuesday's temperature, then add Wednesday's change.

question: A hockey stick originally costs $120. The sports store is offering a 15% discount. What is the sale price of the stick?
questionFr: Un bâton de hockey coûte à l'origine 120 $. Le magasin de sport offre un rabais de 15 %. Quel est le prix de vente du bâton?
hint: First find 15% of $120 (the discount amount), then subtract that from the original price.

question: A camp counsellor divided canoe paddles equally among some groups. Each group got 6 paddles and there were 48 paddles in total. Write and solve an equation to find the number of groups.
questionFr: Un moniteur de camp a réparti des pagaies de canot également entre des groupes. Chaque groupe a reçu 6 pagaies et il y avait 48 pagaies en tout. Écris et résous une équation pour trouver le nombre de groupes.
hint: If each group gets 6 paddles, write an equation: 6 × g = 48, then solve for g.
steps: Divide both sides by 6: g = 48 ÷ 6 = 8 groups

question: A present is wrapped in a rectangular box that is 10 cm long, 6 cm wide, and 4 cm tall. How much wrapping paper (surface area) is needed to cover the box exactly?
questionFr: Un cadeau est emballé dans une boîte rectangulaire mesurant 10 cm de long, 6 cm de large et 4 cm de haut. Quelle surface d'emballage est nécessaire pour couvrir la boîte exactement?
hint: A rectangular box has 3 pairs of faces. Calculate the area of each pair and add them all together.
steps: Find the area of each pair of faces: 2(10×6) + 2(10×4) + 2(6×4)

question: In a bag of 20 hockey cards, 8 are of Toronto Maple Leafs players, 7 are of Montreal Canadiens players, and 5 are of other teams. If you pick a card at random, what is the probability of NOT getting a Leafs card?
questionFr: Dans un sac de 20 cartes de hockey, 8 sont des joueurs des Maple Leafs de Toronto, 7 sont des Canadiens de Montréal et 5 sont d'autres équipes. Si tu piges une carte au hasard, quelle est la probabilité de NE PAS avoir une carte des Leafs?
hint: Find the number of cards that are NOT Leafs cards first, then write it as a fraction of the total.
steps: Cards that are NOT Leafs: 20 - 8 = 12 cards
Probability = 12/20 (which can also be simplified to 3/5)

question: Lena earned money shovelling driveways. She charged $15 per driveway and spent $9 on a new shovel. After the job, she had $51. How many driveways did she shovel?
questionFr: Lena a gagné de l'argent en pelletant des entrées. Elle a chargé 15 $ par entrée et a dépensé 9 $ pour une nouvelle pelle. Après le travail, elle avait 51 $. Combien d'entrées a-t-elle pelletées?
hint: Write an equation: 15d - 9 = 51, where d is the number of driveways.
steps: Set up: 15d - 9 = 51. Add 9 to both sides: 15d = 60
Divide both sides by 15: d = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 driveways

question: A telephone pole on a Canadian farm is 8 metres tall. A support wire is attached from the top of the pole to a point 6 metres from the base on the ground. How long is the wire?
questionFr: Un poteau téléphonique dans une ferme canadienne a 8 mètres de haut. Un câble de soutien est attaché du sommet du poteau à un point à 6 mètres de la base sur le sol. Quelle est la longueur du câble?
hint: The pole, the ground, and the wire form a right triangle. Use a² + b² = c².
steps: Apply the Pythagorean theorem: a² + b² = c², so 6² + 8² = c²

question: A Tim Hortons store sold 350 coffees on Monday. On Tuesday, sales increased by 20%. How many coffees were sold on Tuesday?
questionFr: Un Tim Hortons a vendu 350 cafés lundi. Mardi, les ventes ont augmenté de 20 %. Combien de cafés ont été vendus mardi?
hint: Find 20% of 350 to get the increase, then add it to the original number.

question: A ski hill in British Columbia rises 60 metres over a horizontal distance of 240 metres. What is the slope (rise over run) of the ski hill?
questionFr: Une piste de ski en Colombie-Britannique monte de 60 mètres sur une distance horizontale de 240 mètres. Quelle est la pente (montée sur course) de la piste?
hint: Slope = rise ÷ run. Simplify the fraction after dividing.

question: A square hockey rink practice area has an area of 196 square metres. What is the length of one side of the rink?
questionFr: Une zone d'entraînement de hockey carrée a une superficie de 196 mètres carrés. Quelle est la longueur d'un côté de la patinoire?
hint: To find the side length of a square from its area, take the square root of the area.
steps: Area of a square = side², so side = √196

question: A student is saving up to buy a $250 pair of hockey skates. She already has $70 saved and earns $15 per hour babysitting. How many hours does she need to work to afford the skates?
questionFr: Une élève économise pour acheter des patins de hockey à 250 $. Elle a déjà 70 $ d'épargnés et gagne 15 $ de l'heure en gardant des enfants. Combien d'heures doit-elle travailler pour se payer les patins?
hint: Write an equation: 15h + 70 = 250, and solve for h.

question: A school garden is represented by the expression 3x² + 5x - 2. If x = 3, what is the area value of the expression?
questionFr: Un jardin scolaire est représenté par l'expression 3x² + 5x - 2. Si x = 3, quelle est la valeur de l'expression?
hint: Substitute x = 3 into the expression and follow BEDMAS to evaluate.

question: A canoe rental company in Algonquin Park charges $10 plus $5 per hour. This can be written as C = 5h + 10. What is the cost for a 6-hour canoe rental, and what does the y-intercept represent?
questionFr: Une entreprise de location de canots au parc Algonquin facture 10 $ plus 5 $ de l'heure. On peut l'écrire C = 5h + 10. Quel est le coût pour une location de canot de 6 heures, et que représente l'ordonnée à l'origine?
hint: Substitute h = 6 into the equation. The y-intercept (the constant) tells you what you pay before any hours.
steps: The y-intercept is 10, representing the $10 base/flat rental fee

question: A 2-metre hockey stick casts a shadow of 3 metres at the same time that a flagpole casts a shadow of 18 metres. How tall is the flagpole?
questionFr: Un bâton de hockey de 2 mètres projette une ombre de 3 mètres au même moment où un mât projette une ombre de 18 mètres. Quelle est la hauteur du mât?
hint: Set up a proportion using similar triangles: height/shadow = height/shadow.

question: Seven students tracked how many minutes they read each night: 20, 35, 45, 30, 25, 40, 35. What is the median reading time?
questionFr: Sept élèves ont noté combien de minutes ils lisaient chaque soir : 20, 35, 45, 30, 25, 40, 35. Quel est le temps de lecture médian?
hint: First arrange the numbers in order from smallest to largest, then find the middle value.
steps: Order the values: 20, 25, 30, 35, 35, 40, 45 — there are 7 values
The middle (4th) value is 35, so the median is 35 minutes

question: A soccer ball is kicked and its height (in metres) is modelled by h = -5t² + 20t, where t is time in seconds. How many seconds does it take for the ball to reach the ground again?
questionFr: Un ballon de soccer est botté et sa hauteur (en mètres) est modélisée par h = -5t² + 20t, où t est le temps en secondes. Combien de secondes faut-il pour que le ballon touche à nouveau le sol?
hint: The ball hits the ground when h = 0. Factor the equation to find the values of t.
steps: Solutions: t = 0 (kick) and t = 4, so the ball lands after 4 seconds

question: At a school fundraiser, adult tickets cost $8 and student tickets cost $5. A total of 200 tickets were sold for $1,150. How many adult tickets were sold?
questionFr: Lors d'une collecte de fonds scolaire, les billets adultes coûtent 8 $ et les billets étudiants coûtent 5 $. Au total, 200 billets ont été vendus pour 1 150 $. Combien de billets adultes ont été vendus?
hint: Write two equations: one for total tickets and one for total money. Then solve the system.
steps: Let a = adults, s = students. Equations: a + s = 200 and 8a + 5s = 1150. From first: s = 200 - a

question: A hiker in Banff wants to find the height of a cliff. Standing 50 metres from its base, she measures the angle of elevation to the top as 35°. How tall is the cliff? (Use tan 35° ≈ 0.700)
questionFr: Une randonneuse à Banff veut trouver la hauteur d'une falaise. À 50 mètres de sa base, elle mesure un angle d'élévation de 35°. Quelle est la hauteur de la falaise? (Utilise tan 35° ≈ 0,700)
hint: Use the tangent ratio: tan(angle) = opposite/adjacent, where the adjacent side is the distance to the cliff.

question: A circular skating rink has a diameter of 30 metres. What is the area of the ice surface? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
questionFr: Une patinoire circulaire a un diamètre de 30 mètres. Quelle est l'aire de la surface de glace? (Utilise π ≈ 3,14)
hint: Remember the formula: Area = π × r². The radius is half the diameter.
steps: Radius = 30 ÷ 2 = 15 m. Apply the formula: A = π × r² = 3.14 × 15²

topic: Surface Area and Volume of 3D Shapes
question: A cylindrical container of maple syrup has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 12 cm. What is the volume of the container? (Use π ≈ 3.14)
questionFr: Un contenant cylindrique de sirop d'érable a un rayon de 5 cm et une hauteur de 12 cm. Quel est le volume du contenant? (Utilise π ≈ 3,14)
hint: Volume of a cylinder = π × r² × h.
steps: Apply the formula: V = π × r² × h = 3.14 × 5² × 12

question: The number of bacteria in a science experiment doubles every hour. If you start with 50 bacteria, the function is f(t) = 50 × 2^t. How many bacteria are there after 4 hours?
questionFr: Le nombre de bactéries dans une expérience scientifique double chaque heure. Si tu commences avec 50 bactéries, la fonction est f(t) = 50 × 2^t. Combien de bactéries y a-t-il après 4 heures?
hint: Substitute t = 4 into the function f(t) = 50 × 2^t.

question: An earthquake in the Pacific Ocean had an intensity measured by the equation M = log(I), where I = 1,000,000. What is the magnitude M on the Richter scale?
questionFr: Un tremblement de terre dans l'océan Pacifique avait une intensité mesurée par l'équation M = log(I), où I = 1 000 000. Quelle est la magnitude M sur l'échelle de Richter?
hint: log(1,000,000) means: 10 to what power equals 1,000,000?

question: A Canadian athlete trains by running 5 km on day 1 and increases the distance by 2 km each day. How far in total has she run after 10 days?
questionFr: Une athlète canadienne s'entraîne en courant 5 km le premier jour et augmente la distance de 2 km chaque jour. Quelle distance a-t-elle parcouru en tout après 10 jours?
hint: This is an arithmetic series. Use the formula: Sn = n/2 × (2a + (n-1)d).

question: A Canadian student invests $2,000 in a savings account with 4% interest compounded annually. Using A = P(1 + r)^t, how much will the account be worth after 3 years?
questionFr: Un étudiant canadien place 2 000 $ dans un compte d'épargne avec un taux d'intérêt de 4 % composé annuellement. En utilisant A = P(1 + r)^t, combien vaudra le compte après 3 ans?
hint: Substitute P = 2000, r = 0.04, and t = 3 into the compound interest formula A = P(1 + r)^t.

question: A surveying student simplifies the expression sin²θ + cos²θ + tan²θ × cos²θ. Which of the following is the simplified result?
questionFr: Un étudiant en arpentage simplifie l'expression sin²θ + cos²θ + tan²θ × cos²θ. Quel est le résultat simplifié?
hint: Remember sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, and use the identity tanθ = sinθ/cosθ to simplify the last term.
steps: So the expression becomes sin²θ + cos²θ + sin²θ = 1 + sin²θ... wait, re-evaluate: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, plus sin²θ = 1 + sin²θ. Correct answer requires noting the full original expression sin²θ + cos²θ + tan²θ·cos²θ = 1 + sin²θ. However matching to choices, recalculate: = sin²θ + cos²θ + sin²θ = 1 + sin²θ. The matching choice is 1 + sin²θ... rechecking provided answer=2 doesn't fit. Corrected: answer should be '1 + sin²θ'

question: A company models its average production cost per item (in dollars) with the function C(x) = (500 + 10x) / x, where x is the number of items made. What happens to the average cost as x gets very large, and what is C(50)?
questionFr: Une entreprise modélise son coût moyen de production par article (en dollars) avec la fonction C(x) = (500 + 10x) / x, où x est le nombre d'articles produits. Que se passe-t-il au coût moyen quand x devient très grand, et quelle est la valeur de C(50)?
hint: Rewrite the function by splitting the fraction: C(x) = 500/x + 10. What happens to 500/x as x → ∞?
steps: Rewrite: C(x) = 500/x + 10. As x → ∞, 500/x → 0, so C approaches $10 (the variable cost per item)

question: The position of a model rocket (in metres) is given by s(t) = 3t³ - 12t, where t is time in seconds. What is the rocket's velocity (derivative) at t = 2 seconds?
questionFr: La position d'une fusée modèle (en mètres) est donnée par s(t) = 3t³ - 12t, où t est le temps en secondes. Quelle est la vitesse (dérivée) de la fusée à t = 2 secondes?
hint: Find the derivative s'(t) using the power rule, then substitute t = 2.

question: A hockey team has 15 players. The coach needs to choose 3 players to go to a community event. How many different groups of 3 players can be chosen?
questionFr: Une équipe de hockey compte 15 joueurs. L'entraîneur doit choisir 3 joueurs pour participer à un événement communautaire. Combien de groupes différents de 3 joueurs peuvent être choisis?
hint: Order doesn't matter here (it's a combination). Use C(n, r) = n! / (r!(n-r)!).

question: A canoe paddler heads due north at 4 m/s, but a river current flows due east at 3 m/s. What is the magnitude of the canoe's actual velocity?
questionFr: Un pagayeur de canot se dirige plein nord à 4 m/s, mais un courant de rivière coule plein est à 3 m/s. Quelle est la grandeur de la vitesse réelle du canot?
hint: The two velocities are perpendicular. Use the Pythagorean theorem to find the resultant magnitude.
steps: The velocities form a right triangle: |v| = √(4² + 3²)

question: At a charity hockey tournament, each team has a 30% chance of winning any given game. If a team plays 5 games and each game is independent, what is the probability of winning exactly 2 games? (Use P = C(5,2) × 0.3² × 0.7³)
questionFr: Lors d'un tournoi de hockey de bienfaisance, chaque équipe a 30 % de chances de gagner un match donné. Si une équipe joue 5 matchs indépendants, quelle est la probabilité de gagner exactement 2 matchs? (Utilise P = C(5,2) × 0,3² × 0,7³)
hint: This is a binomial probability problem. Identify n, r, p, and q first: n=5, r=2, p=0.3, q=0.7.
